proves.claim: returnedEchoLines returns one rejectionEchoLine per open REJECT item the agent built, in item order, from the verdict reason and note, and nothing for other seats, claimed or submitted items.

cli.io-next-returned.lines-for-open-reje.why: Without it a builder whose work was sent back would not see the reason on its next call.

proves.claim: returnedEchoLines gives an empty array and never calls verdictFor with no returned item, and calls it once for the one returned item among others.

cli.io-next-returned.reads-only-returned.why: Without it every next call would read a verdict for every item.
